DJIA Market Happenings For Thursday, October 11, 2018 Posted by admin on October 11th, 2018
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include Pfizer (PFE) and Merck (MRK) (intraday for sure). down -62 points.
Wednesday the Dow was down -831.83 (-3.15%) at 25,598.74.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +3.56%.
There were no Dow stocks up Wednesday.
The Dow stock winners Wednesday Wednesday were led by Nike (NKE) -6.81%, Microsoft (MSFT) -5.43%, Visa (V) -4.77%, Boeing (BA) -4.66%, Apple (AAPL) -4.63% and 3M (MMM) -3.93%.
European stocks are lower and Asian markets ended lower.
 one-tenth of a cent at $2.910 reports earnings on 10/11/18 before the market open.
JPMorgan (JPM) reports earnings on 10/12/18 before the market open.
